title: Do Large Language Models Favour Any Research Topics?

bias_targets.methodology: Scoring journal articles for research quality using LLMs and identifying systematically favored or disfavored topics using word frequency chi-squared tests and k-means cluster analysis on titles and abstracts.

Applying word frequency chi-squared tests to identify stylistic terms (e.g., first-person pronouns, indirect language, structured headings) that disproportionately associate with higher or lower LLM quality scores.
Descriptive analysis of average LLM quality scores for articles containing location-specific words, such as country or city names (e.g., Romania, Saudi Arabia, China).
Evaluating systematic differences in LLM quality evaluations by comparing scores generated from title and abstract inputs versus full-text inputs using chi-squared tests.
